telemetry_consent.heading: Help improve Veyrnox
telemetry_consent.body: Share anonymous usage data so we can fix bugs and improve the experience. No personal info, no balances, no wallet addresses, no tracking across apps.
telemetry_consent.device_id_note: A random device ID is used — never linked to your wallet, keys, or identity. You can change this anytime in Settings → Privacy.

duress.heading: Emergency PIN / Hidden Wallet
duress.subhead: A second PIN that opens a separate wallet. Use it if someone forces you to unlock your phone.
duress.warn_banner: Your PIN opens your wallet. The Emergency PIN opens a decoy. Get it wrong 10 times and this phone wipes.
duress.how_body: Set an Emergency PIN different from your real one. Face ID can open the decoy if you want.
duress.timing_note: Veyrnox spends the same effort on every unlock — whether you enter your real PIN or your Emergency PIN — so the one you used isn't given away by how long unlock takes. It's a safeguard for when someone in the room forces you to unlock, not against a remote attacker watching your connection.
duress.fund_title: Fund the Emergency wallet to make it believable
duress.fund_body: An empty wallet looks suspicious. Send a small amount you're willing to hand over. The real balance comes straight from the blockchain — it can't be faked in the app.
fund_notes: A fresh wallet has no history, which makes it less convincing.
Good to know: someone who examines the device may still find the second wallet.
duress.remove_body: Clears the Emergency PIN and its wallet.
duress.setup_err_length: Emergency PIN must be exactly 8 digits
duress.bio_optin_body: {{label}} always opens the decoy. Your real wallet still needs your typed PIN. Anyone forcing you to use {{label}} only ever sees the decoy.
duress.saved_ok: Emergency PIN saved. Emergency wallet created.
duress.bio_optin_failed: {{label}} could not be set up for this wallet. Sign in with your PIN — the Emergency PIN still works. You can try {{label}} again in Security settings.
duress.bio_turned_off: {{label}} sign-in has been turned off. Sign in with your PIN. You can turn {{label}} back on in Security settings whenever you want.
duress.fund_target_lead: Send a small amount of {{symbol}} on {{network}} to make it look lived-in:
duress.balance_unavailable_title: Could not read balance from chain
duress.faucet_hint: Use a public faucet to get free test {{symbol}}, then send some here.
duress.phrase_note: Recovery phrase for the Emergency wallet. Only save this if you want to reach it from another app.
duress.demo_body: Exercises the real unlock flow. Step 1 creates a throwaway real wallet (password {{real}}) and a hidden wallet (Emergency PIN {{duress}}) seeded with a small {{symbol}} balance. Then unlock with either to compare.
duress.demo_step1: 1. Set up real + funded hidden wallet
duress.demo_wrong_pin_hint: (wrong PINs show an error; the Emergency PIN opens its wallet silently)
duress.demo_locked: Locked. Unlock above to see which wallet opens.
duress.demo_only_decoy: In this session you only see the Emergency wallet.
duress.demo_oracle_hidden: ✓ hidden in this hidden wallet session
duress.demo_reset: Reset demo (delete all wallet data + hidden wallet)
duress.non_demo_hint: Lock your wallet and enter the Emergency PIN to try it. Never share it. Forgot it? Remove it here while unlocked with your real PIN.

stealth.heading: Stealth / Hidden Wallets
stealth.subhead: Wallets that never appear in the app and are revealed only by a secret.
stealth.storage_disclosure: Hidden wallets aren't in the secure vault yet (we're working on it). If someone grabs your phone's data, they see the wallet but can't open it without your secret.
stealth.identical_slots_note: Unlock looks and times the same for every wallet, and the hidden-wallet count is never revealed — an examiner sees a fixed pool of identical slots and can't easily tell real from decoy.
stealth.how_body: Create a hidden wallet with its own reveal secret. It appears nowhere in the app. Enter its secret at the normal unlock screen and the app opens that wallet instead of your visible one.
stealth.protects_title: What this protects — and what it does not
protects_items: A fixed pool of identical slots — some real, most decoys — never reveals the count.
The pool exists for every wallet, so it proves "this device has VEYRNOX", not "hidden wallets".
Hidden in the app, not on-chain — addresses and history stay public.
No list is kept: a forgotten secret makes that wallet unrecoverable here.
Back up each seed immediately — a second hidden wallet can silently replace the first in the same slot.
stealth.non_demo_hint: Lock your wallet and enter the reveal secret to open the hidden wallet. Never share a reveal secret — there is no list and no reset.

identity.opt_in_note: Checking a balance contacts that chain's public node — it reveals your address. So it's opt-in and never automatic.

move.title: Move an existing wallet into hidden
move.transition_warning_leading: Weaker than a fresh hidden wallet — read this
move.transition_warning_body: This wallet is already visible — anyone who saw it before can notice it's gone and demand it back. A new hidden wallet they never knew about is safer.
move.pick_prompt: Choose a visible wallet to move into hidden:
move.phrase_placeholder: The 12/24-word phrase for this wallet (proves you control it)
move.phrase_note: The app holds only public data, so you supply the phrase to move the real wallet into hidden. It's encrypted with your reveal secret, never stored in the clear.
move.err_secret_length: Reveal secret must be at least 4 characters.
move.err_phrase_invalid: Enter the valid recovery phrase for this wallet.
move.err_phrase_mismatch: That recovery phrase does not derive this wallet's address. You can only hide a wallet you control.
move.done_message: “{{name}}” is now hidden and removed from your visible wallets.
move.record_deleted_note: Its app record (label, address, cached balance) is deleted — it no longer appears in the list above or elsewhere in the app. It opens only by entering its reveal secret at the normal unlock screen.
move.verify_label: Verify it reveals only with its secret
move.verify_placeholder: enter the reveal secret (or a wrong one)
move.verify_none: No wallet revealed for that secret (a wrong secret looks exactly like “nothing here”).
move.demo_cta: Demo: add a movable wallet + prefill
move.demo_note: Adds a visible “Spare ETH (movable demo)” wallet and fills the phrase + secret ({{secret}}) so you can run the move, watch it vanish from the list above, then verify it reveals only with its secret.

create.title: Create a hidden wallet
create.secret_placeholder: At least 4 characters — different from your main password
create.warn_note: Make it different from your main PIN and Emergency PIN — if it matches, that one opens instead.
create.err_secret_length: Reveal secret must be at least 4 characters
create.saved_ok: Hidden wallet created. It won't show up anywhere in the app. It opens only with its secret.
create.fund_prompt: Fund any chain (send a small testnet amount to the matching address):
create.phrase_note: Hidden wallet recovery phrase (back this up — there is no other copy, and the app keeps no list of hidden wallets to recover from):
create.reminder_note: Remember your reveal secret. To open this wallet later, just enter that secret at the normal unlock screen.

demo.title: Live demonstration (demo mode)
demo.body: Exercises the real unlock flow. Step 1 creates a throwaway visible wallet (password {{real}}) and a hidden wallet (reveal secret {{secret}}) seeded with small balances on all three chains. Then unlock with either to compare — and note the visible session shows no sign the hidden wallet exists.
demo.wrong_secret_hint: (same error for any non-matching password — no tell)
demo.locked: Locked. Unlock above to see which wallet opens.
demo.hidden_body: Revealed via its secret. This session exposes only the hidden wallet's own addresses. The visible wallet is not referenced.
demo.visible_body: This is the visible wallet. The app shows no sign in the app that a hidden wallet exists.
demo.oracle_hidden_is_current: ✓ this is the revealed hidden wallet

session_proposal.title: Connect to dApp?
session_proposal.step_up_required: Step-up re-auth required — unlock again to approve this connection
session_proposal.risk_ack: I understand this site is flagged as a phishing risk and want to connect anyway.
session_proposal.honesty_caveat: Veyrnox checks against {{count}} known scam domains. A clean result does not confirm this site is safe — always verify the dApp URL independently.
session_proposal.domain_caveat: Domain check covers a limited blocklist — absence does not confirm safety.
session_proposal.unsupported_chains_warning: Unsupported chains will be excluded from the approved session.
session_proposal.optional_note: These are optional — the dApp has declared it can work without them. They will be included in the approved session if your wallet supports them.
session_proposal.trust_warning: Only connect to dApps you trust. This wallet will be visible to the dApp once connected.

request_approval.eth_sign_note: Raw byte signing (eth_sign) is disabled — it cannot show you what you are signing.
request_approval.add_chain_note: Adding arbitrary chains is disabled to prevent RPC injection attacks.
request_approval.scam_body: {{name}} ({{domain}}) is on Veyrnox's local known-bad list: {{reason}}. Do not approve unless you are absolutely certain.
request_approval.unresolved_reason: Veyrnox could not verify which dApp made this request (no active session). Treat it as suspicious.
request_approval.personal_sign_hint: Signing this message will NOT send a transaction or cost gas. Only sign messages from dApps you trust.
request_approval.typed_contract_hint: The name above is chosen by the site. This contract address is what your signature actually authorises — check it against the token you expect.
request_approval.permit_ack: I understand this signature authorises a spender to move my tokens
request_approval.max_fee_note: This is the most the network fee can cost, on top of the value above. It is a ceiling, not an estimate — the actual fee is usually far lower.
request_approval.mainnet_flag: ⚠ REAL FUNDS — live mainnet transaction, not testnet. Double-check the network and amount before approving.
request_approval.broadcast_body: Approving sends a real on-chain transaction and costs gas. Only approve requests from dApps you trust. This action cannot be undone.
request_approval.broadcast_ack: I understand this will send a real transaction
request_approval.unknown_method_tail: . Veyrnox cannot safely display or sign this.
request_approval.reauth_notice: Your session has timed out. Please re-authenticate before signing.

active_sessions.empty: No dApps connected yet. Pair one above to get started.

poison.heading: This address looks suspicious — check every character carefully
poison.body: This recipient looks like an address you've used before — same first and last characters, different middle. Scammers craft look-alike addresses hoping you copy the wrong one. We couldn't verify this address; compare every character, not just the ends.
